sowing_emergence.name: Germination & Emergence (0-15 DAS)
risks: Seed rot or fungal damping off due to waterlogging
Crust formation on heavy clay soil obstructing germination
Early sucking pests like thrips and aphids

weatherRules.action: Avoid irrigation and fertilizer broadcasting; ensure drainage channels are open to prevent seed rotting.
High soil surface heat risk; provide light evening sprinkler or furrow irrigation to protect tender seedlings.

vegetative.name: Vegetative Growth & Square Formation (16-50 DAS)
risks: Aphid and jassid infestation curling young leaves
Square (bud) drop due to moisture stress or excessive moisture
Weed competition suppressing root aeration

weatherRules.action: Do not spray foliar nutrients or bio-pesticides within 24 hours of expected rain.
Wind speed exceeds 20 km/h; postpone foliar applications to avoid spray drift loss.
Schedule irrigation in morning or late evening; mulching between rows reduces soil water evaporation.

flowering.name: Flowering & Boll Setting (51-90 DAS)
risks: Pink bollworm larval entry into fresh green bolls
Premature flower and boll shedding from dry spells or sudden heavy downpours
Bacterial blight or grey mildew spread during damp cloudy weather

weatherRules.action: Rain expected; delay any planned protective spray and postpone irrigation.
Extreme heat during peak flowering causes pollen desiccation; ensure uniform soil moisture.
Avoid spraying and inspect tall cotton plants for lodging risk.

maturity_harvest.name: Boll Maturation & Picking (91+ DAS)
risks: Rain wetting open cotton fiber causing discoloration and fungal staining
Mealybug damage on opening bolls
Loss of fiber quality due to delayed picking

weatherRules.action: Rush picking of all open fluffy bolls immediately before rain and store in a completely dry covered shed.
Dry clear weather is ideal for picking cotton after morning dew evaporates.

sowing_seedling.name: Germination & Seedling (0-18 DAS)
risks: Poor emergence if heavy downpour causes soil compaction
Stem fly and girdle beetle infestation at hypocotyl
Seed rot in poorly drained low-lying areas

weatherRules.action: Postpone sowing if heavy rain is forecasted; clear drainage outlets.
If prolonged dry spell threatens young seedlings, apply protective sprinkler irrigation.

vegetative.name: Branching & Canopy Growth (19-40 DAS)
risks: Spodoptera (tobacco caterpillar) defoliation
Yellow mosaic virus transmitted by whiteflies
Weed smothering during first 35 critical days

weatherRules.action: Avoid spraying and weeding operations when rain probability is 60% or higher.
High wind causes spray drift; wait for calm early morning hours.

flowering_pod.name: Flowering & Pod Initiation (41-65 DAS)
risks: Flower drop if moisture stress coincides with blooming
Pod borer larvae damaging young pods
Rust fungus outbreaks in humid cloudy weather

weatherRules.action: Hold off on all foliar sprays and withhold field irrigation.
High daytime temperatures increase pod abortion; irrigate lightly if soil moisture is depleting.

pod_filling_harvest.name: Pod Filling & Maturity (66+ DAS)
risks: Pod shattering if over-dry, or seed discoloration/sprouting if caught in unexpected post-monsoon rain
Charcoal rot under late-season heat stress

weatherRules.action: Rain alert: expedite harvest of mature golden-brown crop and move harvested bundles to elevated dry tarpaulins.
Clear dry sunny days: proceed with morning/evening harvest and threshing.

crown_root_initiation.name: Crown Root Initiation & Tillering (0-35 DAS)
risks: Failure to develop crown roots if CRI irrigation is skipped around 21 DAS
Termite attack in un-decomposed organic matter
Early weed emergence reducing tiller count

weatherRules.action: Delay scheduled CRI irrigation if rainfall of over 10mm is forecast.
Higher winter temperature hurts tillering; ensure sufficient soil moisture.

jointing_booting.name: Jointing & Booting (36-70 DAS)
risks: Yellow / stripe rust appearance in cold humid weather
Nitrogen deficiency showing on lower leaves

weatherRules.action: Postpone fungicide or foliar sprays; avoid water ponding.
Strong wind combined with wet soil causes lodging; do not irrigate under windy forecast.

heading_flowering.name: Heading & Flowering (71-90 DAS)
risks: Aphid infestation in dense stands
Head blight or loose smut development
Terminal heat stress

weatherRules.action: Heat stress alert: apply light evening irrigation or sprinkler misting to keep microclimate cool.
Avoid irrigating tall headed wheat when gusty winds are predicted to prevent lodging.

grain_filling_maturity.name: Grain Filling & Dough Stage (91+ DAS)
risks: Shriveling of grains due to sudden western disturbance heat or hot dry winds
Lodging from hail or storm

weatherRules.action: Hail/rain risk: halt all irrigation; secure drainage and prepare harvest machinery.
Warm winds accelerate ripening prematurely; ensure last protective irrigation is completed before soil dries hard.

nursery_establishment.name: Transplanting & Establishment (0-20 DAS)
risks: Transplant shock, damping off, and cutworm damage
Sun scorch on unhardened nursery seedlings

weatherRules.action: Ensure raised beds have clear furrows for drainage; delay transplanting if flash storm expected.
Protect young transplants from afternoon scorch; irrigate via drip in the evening.

vegetative_branching.name: Vegetative Growth & Staking (21-45 DAS)
risks: Early blight (Alternaria) forming target board spots on lower leaves
Leaf curl virus spread by whiteflies
Lodging of stems without trellis support

weatherRules.action: Avoid spraying foliar remedies right before rain; inspect staking wires.
Inspect bamboo trellis and ties to prevent branch snapping in gusty wind.

flowering_fruiting.name: Flowering & Fruit Development (46-80 DAS)
risks: Blossom end rot caused by calcium deficiency aggravated by erratic watering
Fruit borer (Helicoverpa) boring into green fruits
Late blight in cold wet nights

weatherRules.action: High late-blight risk under rainy humid conditions; delay irrigation and keep beds drained.
Pollen sterility occurs above 36°C; maintain consistent drip irrigation intervals.

harvesting.name: Fruit Ripening & Harvesting (81+ DAS)
risks: Fruit cracking following sudden heavy rainfall after dry spell
Sun scald on fruits exposed after defoliation
Post-harvest rot if picked wet

weatherRules.action: Pick all breaker and mature green/pink fruits immediately before rain to avoid fruit splitting.
Dry clear weather: pick ripe fruits in cool morning hours and pack in ventilated crates.
